example: Hoy enfrentamos el primer día de guardería.
exampleTranslation: Today we faced the first day of nursery.

example: ¿Averiguaste si hay lugar en la guardería?
exampleTranslation: Did you find out if there's a spot at the nursery?

example: Aprovecha que duerme y descansa un rato.
exampleTranslation: Make the most of him sleeping and rest a bit.

example: Superó el miedo al agua en una semana.
exampleTranslation: He got over his fear of the water in a week.

example: Ya alcanza la mesa con las manos.
exampleTranslation: He can already reach the table with his hands.

example: Te cambio el pañal y salimos.
exampleTranslation: I'll change your nappy and we'll head out.

english: to bathe, to give a bath
example: Esta noche te baño con espuma.
exampleTranslation: Tonight I'll give you a bubble bath.

example: Te visto rápido, que hace frío.
exampleTranslation: I'll dress you quickly, it's cold.

example: Te despertaste temprano hoy, ¿eh?
exampleTranslation: You woke up early today, didn't you?

example: Shh, tu hermana está durmiendo.
exampleTranslation: Shh, your sister's sleeping.

example: ¿Jugamos con los bloques un rato?
exampleTranslation: Shall we play with the blocks for a bit?

example: Ahora guardamos los juguetes en la caja.
exampleTranslation: Now we put the toys away in the box.

example: Te limpio la cara, que tienes yogur.
exampleTranslation: Let me wipe your face, you've got yogurt on it.

example: Ven, que te quiero abrazar.
exampleTranslation: Come here, I want to give you a hug.

example: Ya está, no llores, mi amor.
exampleTranslation: There, there, don't cry, my love.

example: Hay que compartir la pala con tu amigo.
exampleTranslation: You have to share the spade with your friend.

example: Espera, que te ayudo a bajar.
exampleTranslation: Wait, I'll help you get down.

example: No empujes a los otros nenes.
exampleTranslation: Don't push the other kids.

example: Apúrate, que llega el colectivo.
exampleTranslation: Hurry up, the bus is coming.

example: Vamos a lavarnos las manos.
exampleTranslation: Let's go and wash our hands.

english: to go to bed, to lie down
example: Es hora de acostarse, a la cama.
exampleTranslation: It's time for bed, off you go.
